name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – § 54 – Am 37
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 54. Supports the establishment of domestic advisory groups by each party to advise on all relevant issues covered by the Agreement; highlights the role of domestic advisory groups in ensuring the effective implementation of the Agreement, in particular as regards the TSD provisions; calls for sufficient financial resources and technical assistance to be allocated to the Domestic Advisory Groups (DAGs) to allow them to be able to properly carry out their tasks;
